fact: Angola's national directorate for telecommunications and IT (Matias Borges) announced two new government data centres in Luanda (Camama and a modernised backup at the Centro Nacional de Dados, Rangel) to migrate existing and new government applications to a unified government cloud, a national cloud costing the State USD 89 million.
INFOSI's director-general says the national PKI root is being installed in the newly inaugurated Government Cloud at Camama, creating a sovereign base controlled in national territory.

The Secretary of State for Telecommunications and Information Technologies said the Government Cloud programme gives priority to migrating public administration services to a unified government data cloud, as reported by INACOM on 15 April 2025.
Menos Fios reports the Government's National Data Centre and Cloud at Camama, inaugurated on 28 April 2026 by President Lourenco, hosts data of public and private institutions.
